name: Super Bock
verdict: Owned by Super Bock Group (56% VIACER Group, 44% Carlsberg Group). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Proposed tier none for issue #434 (2026-09-28). Super Bock Group is privately held: 56% VIACER (Violas family holding), 44% Carlsberg Group, a listed Danish brewer with no state owner. No state or state-fund owner in the chain, so state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md). Super Bock is FC Porto's back-of-shirt sponsor in 2026-27 and a Main Partner of Sporting CP.
